metadata.title: Repairing the iteration-8 research record: demo data for item 0e (the alias-named manifold)
metadata.description: The alias_overlap dataset of full_eval_out.json (15 non-banned alias sets + 5 algorithm centroids, with their lexical overlap and geodesic distance g to the banned five), plus the stored iteration-8 inputs that eval.py's stage 0e reads to recompute it: the 300 x 300 kNN geodesics of the 300 forced prompts (Qwen3-32B NF4, block 31; k = 15 and k = 10), the vendored prompt index, the alias table and the iteration-8 M1 values used by gate E3.
